extractions.unit: A material discrepancy is any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.

unit_attributes.summary: Defines a material discrepancy as any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.

extractions.unit: The applicant must explain any material discrepancies between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity (see 22 CFR 51.25).

context_quotes: A material discrepancy is any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.

alternative_quotes: Court orders or decrees: (a) Name change orders; or (b) Divorce decrees

unit_attributes.choice_quote: submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section
unit_attributes.choice_text: One or more of the following: (1) Court orders or decrees: (a) Name change orders, or (b) Divorce decrees; (2) Certificates of naturalization; (3) Marriage certificates; (4) Documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law; or (5) Documentation of customary usage.
unit_attributes.logic_text: one or more of the documents listed in this section (see an exception for married names in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C)). Acceptable means of documenting a material name change include (per 22 CFR 51.25): (1) Court orders or decrees: (a) Name change orders; or (b) Divorce decrees; (2) Certificates of naturalization; (3) Marriage certificates; (4) Documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law; or (5) Documentation of customary usage.
unit_attributes.action_quote: must be documented by submission of
unit_attributes.object_quote: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity
unit_attributes.object: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity
unit_attributes.summary: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or evidence of identity must be documented by submission of one or more listed documents: court orders or decrees (name change orders or divorce decrees), certificates of naturalization, marriage certificates, documentation demonstrating name change by operation of state law, or documentation of customary usage, subject to an exception for married names.

extractions.unit: see an exception for married names in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C)

scope_quotes: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity must be documented by submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section
unit_attributes.scope_text: Governing the documentation requirement for material discrepancies between the name on the application, evidence of citizenship/nationality, or evidence of identity.
unit_attributes.summary: An exception applies for married names in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C) regarding documenting material discrepancies.

extractions.unit: Evidence of material name changes must be reviewed for evidence of counterfeiting or alteration (see 8 FAM 201.1)

unit_attributes.summary: Evidence of material name changes must be reviewed for evidence of counterfeiting or alteration.

extractions.unit: The applicant may not continue to use a previous name after a material name change unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name (see 8 FAM 403.1-6 regarding “known as” names).

unit_attributes.logic_text: unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name
unit_attributes.summary: The applicant must not continue to use a previous name after a material name change, unless the name change documentation specifically permits continued use of that name.

extractions.unit: unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name

scope_quotes: The applicant may not continue to use a previous name after a material name change
unit_attributes.scope_text: Qualifying the prohibition against using a previous name after a material name change.
unit_attributes.summary: Excepts the prohibition on using a previous name when the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name.

extractions.unit: The applicant's name is an integral part of her/his identity.

unit_attributes.summary: The applicant's name is an integral part of her/his identity.

extractions.unit: Consequently, under 22 CFR 51.23(c), evidence of identity might be required in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant

scope_quotes: in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant
unit_attributes.scope_text: Under 22 CFR 51.23(c), in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant.
context_quotes: The applicant's name is an integral part of her/his identity.
unit_attributes.summary: Evidence of identity might be required under 22 CFR 51.23(c) in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant.

extractions.unit: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change, you must suspend the application to request an acceptable ID in the new name.

scope_quotes: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change
unit_attributes.scope_text: If the applicant had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 and has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change.

unit_attributes.summary: If an applicant had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated ID to reflect it, you must suspend the application to request an acceptable ID in the new name.

extractions.unit: If there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel, a limited-validity passport may be issued in the requested name

scope_quotes: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change
If there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel
unit_attributes.scope_text: When an applicant had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 without updating their ID, and there is insufficient time to request acceptable ID submission prior to urgent or emergency travel.
unit_attributes.logic_text: If there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel
unit_attributes.summary: When an applicant had a material name change over a year before applying on form DS-11 without an updated ID, a limited-validity passport may be issued in the requested name if there is insufficient time to request acceptable ID before urgent or emergency travel.

extractions.unit: The applicant generally will need the name change documentation to change the name on her/his ID.

unit_attributes.summary: The applicant generally will need the name change documentation in order to change the name on her/his ID.

extractions.unit: You must fully notate the name change documentation prior to returning the documentation, including that the documentation was "seen and returned," to the applicant with the information request letter (IRL)

scope_quotes: prior to returning the documentation, including that the documentation was "seen and returned," to the applicant with the information request letter (IRL)
unit_attributes.scope_text: Prior to returning the documentation to the applicant with the information request letter (IRL).

unit_attributes.summary: You must fully notate the name change documentation (including that it was 'seen and returned') prior to returning it to the applicant with the information request letter (IRL).

extractions.unit: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11 do not need to submit ID in the new name.

scope_quotes: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11

unit_attributes.logic_text: within one year of applying on a form DS-11
unit_attributes.summary: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on form DS-11 are not required to submit ID in the new name.

extractions.unit: However, if the ID has not yet been changed, they must submit their name change documentation.

scope_quotes: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11
if the ID has not yet been changed
unit_attributes.scope_text: For applicants who had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11, if the ID has not yet been changed.
unit_attributes.logic_text: if the ID has not yet been changed
unit_attributes.summary: If the ID has not yet been changed, applicants who had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11 must submit their name change documentation.

evidence_quotes: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity must be documented by submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section (see an exception for married names in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C)).
relationships.explanation: Parenthetical clause notes an exception in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C) for married names to the requirement to document material discrepancies via the listed documents.

evidence_quotes: The applicant may not continue to use a previous name after a material name change unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name
relationships.explanation: Carves out an exception to the prohibition on using a previous name after a material name change when the documentation specifically permits continued use.
